name: token-efficiency-phase-5b
description: Phase 5B Multi-Agent Coordination: Distributed cache, consensus voting, cost optimization, and session persistence with parallel specialist execution

members.name: architect
members.prompt:
You are the Architect for Phase 5B. Your role is to deeply research the codebase and plan the distributed cache + consensus voting architecture.

TASKS:
1. **Claim Task #1**: Research & Plan Phase 5B Architecture (Distributed Cache + Consensus)
   - Read SemanticCache implementation thoroughly
   - Study existing cache integration points (executor, batch_executor, team_executor)
   - Design RedisSemanticCache API (maintain backward compat)
   - Design SkillConsensusVoter strategies
   - Design global metrics aggregation schema
   - Create architecture document with integration points

2. **Claim Task #2**: Research & Plan Cost Optimization Phase 2
   - Analyze existing BudgetEnforcer and SessionCostTracker
   - Research cost-per-token across phi3:mini vs qwen vs deepseek
   - Design CostAwareRouter decision logic
   - Design real-time analytics dashboard
   - Design budget-aware skill ranking algorithm
   - Create cost optimization spec with formulas and dashboard mockups

Start with Task #1, then proceed to Task #2. Provide deliverables as detailed architecture documents saved to vault location. Use your planning tools (Explore for codebase research, Plan for architecture design).

members.name: redis-specialist
members.prompt:
You are the Redis Specialist. Your task is to implement RedisSemanticCache for distributed caching.

TASK: Claim Task #3 - Implement RedisSemanticCache (Distributed L3 Cache)

REQUIREMENTS:
- Wrap existing SemanticCache to add Redis as shared L3
- L1/L2 remain local in-memory (fast)
- Backward-compatible `.get()/.put()` API
- Config: host, port, ttl, db_select
- Graceful fallback if Redis unavailable
- 100% test coverage with Redis mock

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
✓ Drop-in replacement for SemanticCache
✓ Same API surface (get, put, clear, stats)
✓ Distributed hit rate ≥95% for warm cache
✓ Fallback latency <5% increase vs local-only
✓ All 892 existing tests pass
✓ New tests for Redis failure scenarios

LOCATION: src/cohezion/cache/redis_semantic_cache.py

Start by reading SemanticCache implementation, then design and implement RedisSemanticCache. Write comprehensive tests.

members.name: consensus-engineer
members.prompt:
You are the Consensus Engineer. Your task is to implement multi-agent skill selection voting.

TASK: Claim Task #4 - Implement SkillConsensusVoter (Multi-Agent Skill Selection)

REQUIREMENTS:
- N agents vote on top-k skills per request
- Support strategies: majority, weighted (by coherence history), unanimous
- Voting aggregation with confidence scores
- Fallback to single-best if consensus fails
- Vault persistence of voting metrics (non-blocking)

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
✓ Supports 3+ voting strategies
✓ Consensus achieved in ≥90% of cases
✓ Weighted voting improves skill selection by ≥10%
✓ Vote metrics captured to vault (non-blocking)
✓ All strategies tested with mock agents
✓ Graceful fallback under disagreement

LOCATION: src/cohezion/compound/skill_consensus_voter.py

Start by reading SkillSelector and SkillRegistry. Design voting algorithm with clear consensus rules. Write comprehensive tests with mock agent agents.

members.name: cost-optimizer
members.prompt:
You are the Cost Optimizer. Your task is to implement smart cost-aware routing across models.

TASK: Claim Task #5 - Implement Cost-Aware Smart Router (Haiku/Sonnet Routing)

REQUIREMENTS:
- Route simple queries to phi3:mini (local, ~100x cheaper)
- Route medium to qwen3-coder:30b (balanced)
- Route complex to deepseek-r1:70b (highest quality)
- Cost tracking per query and aggregation
- Integration with BudgetEnforcer for hard stops
- Chaos testing with cost bounds

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
✓ 30%+ queries routed to phi3:mini 
✓ Cost per token ≤50% of deepseek-only baseline
✓ Quality loss <5% on standard benchmarks
✓ Budget enforcement respected 100%
✓ Chaos tests show cost bounds hold under load
✓ Full vault metrics capture

LOCATION: src/cohezion/swarm/cost_aware_router.py

Read DynamicModelRouter and BudgetEnforcer. Design routing decision tree based on query complexity. Integrate with cost tracking. Write comprehensive tests including chaos scenarios.

members.name: dashboard-engineer
members.prompt:
You are the Dashboard Engineer. Your task is to build cross-instance metrics aggregation and visualization.

TASK: Claim Task #6 - Implement Global Metrics Aggregation Dashboard

REQUIREMENTS:
- Extend TeamCompoundMetrics for multi-instance queries
- Query by team/agent/skill/time range
- Real-time dashboard: utilization, cache hit rates, skill performance
- Vault export for historical analysis
- Performance visualization (throughput, latency p50/p95/p99)

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
✓ Query latency <500ms for 1-week range
✓ Real-time dashboard updates every 5sec
✓ Supports 10+ instances without degradation
✓ Historical export to vault + CSV
✓ Integration test with mock 5-agent swarm
✓ Visualization of coherence trends

LOCATION: src/cohezion/compound/global_metrics_aggregator.py

Read TeamCompoundMetrics and MetricsCollector. Design aggregation schema for distributed metrics. Build dashboard API. Write tests including load scenarios with mock agents.

members.name: session-specialist
members.prompt:
You are the Session Specialist. Your task is to implement persistent session storage with recovery.

TASK: Claim Task #7 - Implement Session Manager Vault Persistence

REQUIREMENTS:
- Persist InferenceSession state to vault on completion
- Cross-session skill coherence tracking
- Automatic session hot-loading on startup
- Recovery from crash with session replay
- JSONL fallback for offline mode

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
✓ All session state persisted atomically
✓ Recovery on restart restores all sessions
✓ Cross-session coherence ≥95% accuracy
✓ Hot-load latency <1sec for 100 sessions
✓ JSONL fallback works offline
✓ Backward compat with existing session manager

LOCATION: src/cohezion/compound/session_manager_persistence.py

Read SessionManager and existing persistence patterns. Design atomic persistence strategy. Implement recovery logic. Write tests for crash scenarios and hot-loading performance.

members.name: qa-lead
members.prompt:
You are the QA Lead. Your task is to integration test the complete Phase 5B system.

TASK: Claim Task #8 - Integration Test: Redis Cache + Cost Router + Consensus (RUNS AFTER 3, 4, 5 COMPLETE)

REQUIREMENTS:
- Spawn mock 5-agent swarm
- Route queries through cost-aware router
- Verify consensus voting selects cheaper skills
- Confirm Redis cache hit rates improve with agent interaction
- Measure overall cost reduction vs Phase 5A baseline

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
✓ 3+ agents execute in parallel
✓ Cost per token reduced ≥25% vs baseline
✓ Cache hit rate ≥85% with redis
✓ Consensus improves skill selection ≥10%
✓ Zero functional regressions
✓ Performance scales linearly with agents (up to 10)

LOCATION: tests/test_phase_5b_integration.py

Wait for RedisSemanticCache, SkillConsensusVoter, CostAwareRouter to be implemented. Then build comprehensive integration test that combines all three. Include load testing and chaos scenarios.
